recommendation_3: Insert a nn.Dropout(p=0.2) layer between the hidden layer (mid_dim) and the final output layer (self.fc) in the Net class.
rationale_3: With high label skew (e.g., Client 0 dominating in class 5), the model is prone to overfitting on the majority class of the local client. Dropout prevents co-adaptation of neurons and improves generalization across clients.
recommendation_4: Increase the depth of the MLP by adding a second hidden layer (self.fc2) with 50 units and a ReLU activation between self.fc1 and self.fc.
rationale_4: A single hidden layer of 100 units may lack the capacity to represent the complex decision boundaries required when different clients have vastly different class distributions.
recommendation_5: Change the activation function in the forward method from F.relu to F.leaky_relu with a negative slope of 0.01.
rationale_5: Leaky ReLU prevents the 'dying ReLU' problem where neurons become inactive during training, which can happen frequently in FL when gradients are noisy due to extreme Non-IID imbalances.
recommendation_6: Replace the SGD optimizer in the train function with torch.optim.Adam with a learning rate of 0.001.
rationale_6: Adam provides adaptive learning rates for each parameter, which helps the model converge faster and more reliably than standard SGD when dealing with the heterogeneous gradient updates typical of Dirichlet-partitioned data.
